agency.intro: We are writing because {reason}, and this entry may be relevant to your work: "{title}".
agency.ask: If this is not relevant to you, no action is needed, and replying "stop" ensures you hear nothing further. If we have misread the evidence, replies are read by a person and corrections are published.

ngo_foundation.intro: We are writing because {reason}. This evidence entry may be a candidate for a small, cheap test by your teams or partners: "{title}".
ngo_foundation.ask: If this is not relevant to you, no action is needed, and replying "stop" ensures you hear nothing further. If we have misread the evidence, replies are read by a person and corrections are published.

researcher.intro: We are writing because {reason}. We publish sourced evidence entries with their limits stated, and would value your critique of this one: "{title}".
researcher.ask: A correction, a missing study or a replication we should cite is the most useful reply, and corrections are published with credit. Replying "stop" ensures you hear nothing further.

media.intro: We are writing to your published press or contact address because {reason}. This is a sourced, checkable entry, offered as a possible reference, not a pitch for coverage: "{title}".
media.ask: Every claim links to its source and states its limits, so it can be checked in minutes. Replying "stop" ensures you hear nothing further, and a correction request is answered by a person.

community.intro: We are writing because {reason}. If your readers or members collect practical, evidence-based solutions, this entry may fit a roundup: "{title}".
community.ask: If this is not a fit, no action is needed, and replying "stop" ensures you hear nothing further.
